args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger/batteries
- Travel insurance information
- Emergency contact information

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes/sandals for beach activities
- Hiking shoes/boots for Diamond Head hike
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Quick-dry clothing

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking gear for Diamond Head
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries
- Prescription medications
- Motion sickness medication (for boat trips)
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hair ties/clips
- Travel-sized laundry detergent

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Portable power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Headphones

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel pillow and eye mask
- Books/magazines for downtime
- Small backpack for day trips
- Ziplock bags for wet items
- Travel umbrella (just in case)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach toys, cooler
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Trekking poles, trail map
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Cooler, snacks, playlist
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress if desired
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Waterproof watch, dry bag
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags

Remember to check weather forecasts before departure and adjust accordingly!
